dedupe_keys.name: city of san diego development permits and approvals development services

description: The City of San Diego publishes approvals for permits, maps, agreements and other applications processed by its Development Services Department, including permits needed for new construction, additions, remodelling and repairs to electrical, mechanical and plumbing systems, with a full list of record types in the metadata. Files are split into created, issued, closed and active approvals, for all years (for example created approvals about 654 MB and issued approvals about 557 MB) and for single years such as 2024, 2025 and 2026, and records carry development and project identifiers, project type (such as building construction), status, processing code, approval type and dates. The dataset page showed it was updated daily, last on 25 September 2026. Coverage: City of San Diego. Access: free CSV downloads. Licence: Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and License (PDDL). Caveats: approvals mix many record types beyond building permits, so users must filter by type, and project and approval tables need joining. Simulation uses: tracking new construction and alterations to update city building stock, housing supply and grid load models. Related records: the Austin issued construction permits and NYC DOB permit issuance.
